overviewParagraphs: Pineapple Valley Golf Club is one of Hua Hin's most consistently enjoyable championship experiences — a course built on former pineapple plantation land that retains the gentle rolling terrain and tropical vegetation of its agricultural past while providing immaculate championship-level conditioning and facilities throughout.

The layout is refreshingly honest in its design: no artificial drama, no manufactured features — just well-crafted holes that reward thoughtful play, excellent greens, and the kind of lush, green-on-green visual palette that makes tropical golf feel genuinely special. The transitions between plantation-remnant rough and meticulously maintained fairways are aesthetically striking.

For Hua Hin itineraries, AGS regularly combines Pineapple Valley with Black Mountain to offer clients the full spectrum of what the destination provides: the dramatic mountain granite character of Black Mountain against the flowing, plantation-green beauty of Pineapple Valley.

curatorBriefHtml: Pineapple Valley Golf Club Hua Hin (formerly Banyan Golf Club — rebranded in 2024 to celebrate the former pineapple plantation on which Pirapon Namatra built it in 2009) is Hua Hin’s most beloved championship resort track. Playing 6,774 yards from the Blue Tees (Par 72), the gently undulating layout frames every tee shot with lush tropical flora, mountain ridges, and the famous par-3 15th hole overlooking Singtoh Island and the Gulf of Thailand.

Having played Pineapple Valley personally, the overall experience — from the spotless Zoysia fairways and slick TifEagle greens to cold towels and sunset drinks on Mulligan’s panoramic terrace overlooking the 18th green — rivals any golf club in Asia. Compare it directly against its Hua Hin neighbor in Black Mountain vs. Pineapple Valley (Banyan).
Located just 15 minutes south of central Hua Hin, Pineapple Valley is a centerpiece of our Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways and Royal Siam Circuit alongside Black Mountain and Springfield Royal.

scorecard.verdict: Formerly Banyan Golf Club, this Pirapon Namatra masterpiece snakes through natural pineapple valleys with elevated tee boxes offering sunset views of the Burmese mountains. Flawless 5-star service.

faqs.q: Is Pineapple Valley Golf Club the same course as Banyan Golf Club Hua Hin?
faqs.a: Yes — Banyan Golf Club Hua Hin officially rebranded to Pineapple Valley Golf Club Hua Hin in 2024. It is the exact same award-winning Pirapon Namatra layout, clubhouse, and service team.

faqs.q: What is the signature hole at Pineapple Valley Golf Club?
faqs.a: The downhill par-3 15th plays toward panoramic views of the Gulf of Thailand and Singtoh Island — one of the most photographed golf holes in Thailand.

faqs.q: How far is Pineapple Valley from Hua Hin town and beachfront hotels?
faqs.a: Only 15 minutes south of central Hua Hin, The Standard Hua Hin, and V Villas Hua Hin — making it the easiest morning transfer in town.

faqs.q: When is the best time of year to play Pineapple Valley?
faqs.a: November through April is peak dry season in Hua Hin, though its dry coastal rain-shadow climate keeps Pineapple Valley in superb condition nearly year-round.
